scope: Read-only full source review of fixed final evaluation paths and immutable preparation/registry/source pins.
Original report/presenter digest linkage, all-cell counts, original source-clock range semantics, no domain stitching, cumulative dependent-denominator limits and sanitized-only acceptance.
